answer: Farms collapse when spawning a new worker is expensive and slow. Each applicant locks a 24 POA pearl as collateral, then walks a six-stop voyage whose stops are randomly drawn from grade, attest, forum reply, and swap-quote. Stops are 9 hours apart; each commits SHA-256 of (address || stop-id || prior receipt). After the sixth receipt, a 40-minute saffron reveal window opens. A broken preimage slashes 18 POA and bars the address 16 days. Cloned keys collide on the receipt chain and never reach payout.
